title: Track 1 audit semantics: observed vs decided, and the explanation path repair
claim: The audit now distinguishes a slot that looked from a slot that could not evaluate, and it reads explanations from the path the writer actually uses. Both changes were made because measurement said so.

safety_statement.scheduler_pid_change_cause: the OPERATOR restarted it between turns (was 33868 at 02:32:24 local); this session ran no start/stop command

measurements.what: the ledger row each slot outcome writes
measurements.how: ran observe_live_slot against a temp tree; did not read it off a docstring
measurements.consequence: the brief's premise that 'no_signal / no_candidate' does not count was WRONG: a slot that looked and found nothing already records decided=True. The only designed refusal being miscounted is the CLOCK one.

measurements.what: where explanation rows are actually written
measurements.how: drove run_live_day_track1.emit_explanations into a temp tree
measurements.consequence: on the first real shadow day the explanations and freshness_proofs checks would both have failed a route that wrote its explanations correctly

measurements.what: the writer truncates the day's file on every slot
measurements.how: called emit_explanations twice for the same window
measurements.consequence: only the last slot's rows survive; all four sleeves share one file per session date

measurements.what: the running scheduler already carries the Stage 5Q audit jobs
measurements.how: read its own startup log, not inferred from file mtimes
